additional_info.subject: Note from RC
additional_info.body: Yesterday we put the station into operation remotely together with the customer. However, we have some problems: No1: The station does not go online in the OCPP backend. -> The configuration has already been checked several times. Since the router can be configured via SCB, I think it may be due to the SIM card. Can you please access the charger via SSH and check whether a SIM is inserted or what the error may be. No2: Several ErrorFlags red/yellow are active. The charger cannot be put into operation. Please check. If an intervention is necessary, please send me the work order as soon as possible, then I can go there next Monday
